label_config.support: truncate outside original bbox; no minimum sigma or peak normalization
label_config.target: quantized>0 cast float32; max union over positive boxes
label_config.positive_objects: all valid non-ignore non-crowd boxes fully inside crop core9; no size/class filter
label_config.valid_domain: old_background_mask union full_positive_box_rects, then excluded-object bbox+2px overrides
label_config.excluded_objects: all valid ignore/crowd or non-full-core boxes; original float box+2px
label_config.loss: unchanged official SoftLoUloss on gathered valid pixels per window; four-window mean
label_config.empty_target_window: retain official loss1 and zero gradient; log occurrence
label_config.alignment_limit: approximate mask generator and masked domain; not exact author training reproduction
